", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0082", "tag": "p", "text": "“It might be quicksilver, but it isn’t,” Henry whispered to Francis. “I have never seen the like of any similar metal. “It might be quicksilver, but it isn’t,” Henry whispered to Francis. “I have never seen the like of any similar metal. It strikes me as hotly molten.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0083", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is very cold,” the Queen corrected him in English. “Yet is it fire.—You, Francis, feel the bowl outside.”", "sha256": "ee69ea7cbf85ef3bc9a3f14f74bd55b1be6c6e49a735243433650aa42b8b63a6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1724]", "source_html": "

“It is very cold,” the Queen corrected him in English. “Yet is it fire.—You, Francis, feel the bowl outside.”

He obeyed, laying his full palm unhesitatingly to the yellow outer surface.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0085", "tag": "p", "text": "“Colder than the atmosphere of the room,” he adjudged.", "sha256": "f883285108e8610b2d7cbad1901885d24ecc821dadd4d627ef893403a293c781", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1726]", "source_html": "

“Colder than the atmosphere of the room,” he adjudged.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0086", "tag": "p", "text": "“But look!” the Queen cried, tossing more powder upon the contents. “It is fire that remains cold.”", "sha256": "6729840c0724f1f9d4c60fdc0fc874f569d8c56b6a6aa2a7450bafcc87e4c36c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1727]", "source_html": "

“But look!” the Queen cried, tossing more powder upon the contents. “It is fire that remains cold.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0087", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is the powder that smokes with the heat of its own containment,” Torres blurted out, at the same time feeling into the bottom of his coat pocket. He drew forth a pinch of crumbs of tobacco, match splinters, and cloth-fluff. “This will not burn,” he challenged, inviting invitation by extending the pinch of rubbish over the bowl as if to drop it in.", "sha256": "cb8ea4407af0ac4da7709dbf40898b0febafa0df44d597a5ce5bf4dd1673b4d9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1728]", "source_html": "

“It is the powder that smokes with the heat of its own containment,” Torres blurted out, at the same time feeling into the bottom of his coat pocket. He drew forth a pinch of crumbs of tobacco, match splinters, and cloth-fluff. “This will not burn,” he challenged, inviting invitation by extending the pinch of rubbish over the bowl as if to drop it in.

187“Still is it cold,” said Torres, imitating Francis and feeling the outside of the bowl.

“Thrust your finger into the contents,” the Queen suggested to Torres.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0091", "tag": "p", "text": "“No,” he said.", "sha256": "8376ec1b8c9c7c20ef2e2e31726a6c7c3032a66543658e1345502941155c1f42", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1732]", "source_html": "

“No,” he said.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0092", "tag": "p", "text": "“You are right,” she confirmed. “Had you done so, you would now be with one finger less than the number with which you were born.” She tossed in more powder. “Now shall each behold what he alone will behold.”", "sha256": "8e21c2caf10b80dbf9c52217016ca73f93c6000b9dffa09dc639d1996d58d4ea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1733]", "source_html": "

“You are right,” she confirmed. “Had you done so, you would now be with one finger less than the number with which you were born.” She tossed in more powder. “Now shall each behold what he alone will behold.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0093", "tag": "p", "text": "And it was so.", "sha256": "b0f35387a0820a946ac1c880a642959c89b62b0deec099009958a9a6167d637d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1734]", "source_html": "

And it was so.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0094", "tag": "p", "text": "To Leoncia was it given to see an ocean separate her and Francis. To Henry was it given to see the Queen and Francis married by so strange a ceremony, that scarcely did he realise, until at the close, that it was a wedding taking place. The Queen, from a flying gallery in a great house, looked down into a magnificent drawing-room that Francis would have recognized as builded by his father had her vision been his. And, beside her, his arm about her, she saw Francis. Francis saw but one thing, vastly perturbing, the face of Leoncia, immobile as death, with thrust into it, squarely between the eyes, a slender-bladed dagger. Yet he did not see any blood flowing from the wound of the dagger. Torres glimpsed the beginning of what he knew must be his end, crossed himself, and alone of all of them shrank back, refusing to see further. While the Sun Priest saw the vision of his secret sin, the face and form of the woman for whom he had betrayed the Worship of the Sun, and the face and form of the maid of the village at the Long House.", "sha256": "94029001dcd8e9fb2f1a1c2deebbc917ff2279b5518d8d3aea9de45658fedef4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1735]", "source_html": "

To Leoncia was it given to see an ocean separate her and Francis. To Henry was it given to see the Queen and Francis married by so strange a ceremony, that scarcely did he realise, until at the close, that it was a wedding taking place. The Queen, from a flying gallery in a great house, looked down into a magnificent drawing-room that Francis would have recognized as builded by his father had her vision been his. And, beside her, his arm about her, she saw Francis. Francis saw but one thing, vastly perturbing, the face of Leoncia, immobile as death, with thrust into it, squarely between the eyes, a slender-bladed dagger. Yet he did not see any blood flowing from the wound of the dagger. Torres glimpsed the beginning of what he knew must be his end, crossed himself, and alone of all of them shrank back, refusing to see further. While the Sun Priest saw the vision of his secret sin, the face and form of the woman for whom he had betrayed the Worship of the Sun, and the face and form of the maid of the village at the Long House.
